rationale.text: The only title element is in body: a template wrote it after the head. The methodology looks for the title structured with a title element in the document and does not say whether one outside head gives the page its title. The custom check answers cannot_tell (step 4: the first title element is not a child of head); only the record supports this branch. axe's document-title reads document.title, which the browser takes from the first title element wherever it is, so it reports no fault. With no fault on the unresolved requirement and a resolving link answering cannot_tell, the reason at full is cannot_tell; at fail_only, needs_review, not_enabled.

citations.quote: Retrouver dans le document le titre structuré au moyen d’un élément `<title>` ;
Chaque page web a-t-elle un titre de page (balise `<title>`) ?
